run_basic_sweep: run the basic sweep to generate ensemble configurations for num_ensemble values 1, 3, 10, 30, 100
run_boot_sweep: run the boot sweep to generate ensemble configurations for distribution values none, bernoulli, exponential
run_weight_decay_sweep: run the weight decay sweep to generate ensemble configurations for l2_weight_decay values 0.1, 0.3, 1, 3, 10
run_combined_sweep: run the combined sweep to generate ensemble configurations from basic, boot, and weight_decay sweeps
build_paper_agent: build a paper agent with default ensemble config, make_agent constructor, and combined sweep
